titulo_es: A digital voucher · Public forms and notices

texto: In a form, read the label of each field and do not confuse the time limit with the date of issue. Administrative texts often use compact substantive texts such as «ansøgning» (request).
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
